findings: All 15 printed blocks, their fields and pin glyphs compared with individual native crops, full-source overview and final public preview.
Negative LAB bit 02 feeds BA and AX at printed diamonds; positive LAB bit 02 feeds MA011/031/041/091/101 and AW, while the powered MA521 output remains separate.
The lower decoder preserves the source-specific MA041AS4 bit-04 reference, AZ D02/D08 local undriven tie, five AY negation inputs and MA701 output.
External references, connector table, date, revision and footer match the native page.

human_OR_function_corrections.scope: Exact printed function-label tokens only; all geometric and routing fields unchanged
